title: Residue fields of closed points over an algebraically closed field
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-algebraic-closure] and let $X$ be a scheme locally of finite type over $k$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], with structure morphism $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. For every closed point $x\in X$ [def-weil-closed-points] the homomorphism $k\to\kappa(x)$ induced by $f$ on residue fields [def-weil-residue-field] is an isomorphism; equivalently, the composite $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(x)\to X\xrightarrow{f}\operatorname{Spec}k$ is an isomorphism.
